items.title: Income Tax
items.fullDescription: Return preparation, planning, and representation structured around deadlines and documentation. Advice stays practical for individuals, founders, and operating businesses.

items.title: GST Compliance
items.fullDescription: Monthly and quarterly GST work including returns, reconciliations, e-way bill hygiene, and advisory on input tax credit. Designed for businesses that want a calm filing calendar.

items.title: Bookkeeping Services
items.fullDescription: Day books, ledgers, bank reconciliations, and MIS packaged so tax, GST, and audit work starts from clean records rather than reconstruction.

items.title: Project Finance
items.fullDescription: Feasibility notes, projections, and funding documentation for lenders and promoters. Reports are written for decision-makers who need numbers they can defend.

items.title: Subsidy Services
items.fullDescription: Guidance on industrial and MSME incentive pathways, documentation checklists, and application hygiene so claims are complete before they leave the office.

items.title: ROC Compliance
items.fullDescription: Company and LLP filings, event-based forms, and secretarial hygiene coordinated with accounts so statutory calendars stay intact.

items.title: Investment Advisory
items.fullDescription: Practical conversations on surplus allocation, tax-aware investing, and documentation — always within the professional scope of a chartered accountancy practice.
